basics.name: Vitalii Serbyn

basics.summary: AI engineer and architect. I design and run multi-agent systems on Claude and other LLMs, measure where agents report success they did not earn, and bring LLM bills down. Claude Certified Architect (Professional). 13+ years of production engineering.

Built Crest, a content marketing engine with tiered multi-model routing, editorial and fabrication checks, and publishing to LinkedIn and X
Cut own-platform LLM spend 58% ($82 to $34/month) via multi-model routing and semantic caching, without lowering output quality
Contract, AI platform (assisterr, 2025): designed and shipped a quality-oracle service that verifies AI-agent quality before payment
Contract, platform engineering (Vitelle, 2026 to present): release engineering end to end, 26 store builds shipped in 2026
